description: This file defines a performance tracing target for the Git trace2 subsystem, including initialization, formatting, and writing trace events related to performance metrics, commands, threads, processes, and other runtime events.

methods.name: fn_init
methods.description: Initializes the performance trace target, setting up environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: fn_term
methods.description: Terminates the performance trace target, disabling tracing.

methods.name: perf_fmt_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a formatted trace line prefix with event details, including time, thread, event name, repository, elapsed time, category, and indentation.

methods.name: perf_io_write_fl
methods.description: Writes a formatted trace line with event payload to the performance destination.

methods.name: fn_start_fl
methods.description: Logs the start of a process or command execution.

methods.name: fn_exit_fl
methods.description: Logs the exit of a process or command with its return code.

methods.name: fn_signal
methods.description: Logs a signal received by the process.

methods.name: maybe_append_string_va
methods.description: Appends formatted string to buffer if format is provided.

methods.name: fn_error_va_fl
methods.description: Logs an error event with formatted message.

methods.name: fn_region_enter_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Logs region entry with optional label and category.

methods.name: fn_region_leave_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Logs region exit with elapsed time.
